commits.subject: chore: add beads for VCS project completion plan

top_tasks.title: Workspace allocator hands a sase_<N> clone to a second agent while another agent is still RUNNING in it
top_tasks.why: Root cause of two agents sharing one checkout; every symptom downstream of it is silent and irreversible.

top_tasks.title: Concurrent bead sync can silently delete an event from a shared event stream, wedging every later sync
top_tasks.why: Destroys committed bead history and then blocks every subsequent sase bead sync from that workspace.

top_tasks.title: sase stitch create's _stage_all_except swept a concurrent agent's uncommitted work into an unrelated commit, already pushed to origin/master
top_tasks.why: Already published another agent's in-flight work to origin/master; blast radius of sase-lb and worth hardening independently.

top_tasks.title: test_core_vcs_log.py classify_origin/parse golden-comparison nodes are live reproducible flakes blocking the flake-baseline gate
top_tasks.why: Five of the twelve reproducible flakes currently exceeding the baseline, with 15 independent corroborations; blocks just check-full for every agent.

top_tasks.title: Flake gate counts audit failures from dirty workspaces, so one agent's in-progress edit blocks everyone's check-full
top_tasks.why: Mechanism fix: stops one agent's uncommitted edits from becoming shared flake debt that gates everyone else.

top_tasks.title: Prune or archive hidden agent-artifact index rows: 4,706 of 6,775 rows are hidden and nothing ever removes them
top_tasks.why: The index is 107 MB today and grows ~46 hidden rows/day; it is the mechanism making ACE startup worse every week.

top_tasks.title: resolve_agent_page_url has no cache: refreshes the whole family-name registry on every TUI selection (400-800ms)
top_tasks.why: Verified uncached in src/sase/ace/tui/models/agent_page_url.py; a sub-second stall on an interaction you make constantly.

output_variables.triage_summary: 2026-08-14 task triage: 47 ready task beads reviewed, 7 kept (ranked in top_tasks_ranked), 40 closed with reasons; 2 in_progress beads (sase-j0, sase-ly) left untouched.
